text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I lost!
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Reporting results. I have placed in the
race but
failed to defeat either of my
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you. And also, I am terribly
sorry.
Trainer...
choice_data_list: Let's put this experience to good use next time!

text_block_list.text:
She looks at me with a vaguely lost
expression. I
can't help but worry about
her health.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I feel as though I might run off at any
moment if I
fail to restrain myself.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My jaw is clenching of its own volition,
and
negative emotions are rising within
me, not unlike
an uncontrolled wildfire.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
System controls are malfunctioning.
Emergency
maintenance required.

Seeing Mihono Bourbon's panicked
demeanor, I
can't help but burst out
laughing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I don't understand your reaction.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Frustration"?
choice_data_list: You must be feeling really frustrated, huh?

text_block_list.text:
I tell her how most people feel happy
when they
win and frustrated when they
lose.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Winning creates "happiness." Losing
creates
"frustration." New knowledge
acquired.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That explains my current status.

Mihono Bourbon places a hand on her
chest, as if
to physically check her
emotions.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This "frustration" feels hot inside me.
However, it
is not the only thing I feel.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My "desire to win" is also growing at an

exponential rate.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I... I want to compete against
even
stronger opponents.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: For example... Tokai Teio!

As she is now, Mihono Bourbon could
certainly
rival Tokai Teio.

But Tokai Teio's currently recovering
from an
injury, so I try to think of the
race she'll most
likely enter after
healing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So that's Mihono Bourbon!

And so, a new battle begins. We put our
all into
daily training once more as we
head for the Japan
Cup!
